topic: break in a new baseball glove
core_question: How do I break in a stiff new baseball glove? (secondary: How do I get rid of fleas on my cat?)
answer_summary: Work leather/glove conditioner oil into the pocket and fingers, place a ball in the pocket, fold the glove closed around it, and bind it tightly with cord or rubber bands overnight, repeating over days to form the pocket.; after the topic shift: Apply a vet-recommended topical or oral flea preventive to the cat, comb through with a fine flea comb, and wash bedding and vacuum the home to eliminate fleas and eggs in the environment.
persona: impatient and curt; writing terse one-liners
